topology_reasoning.device_identification: Four-port, fourfold-symmetric multimode waveguide crossing formed by two orthogonal expanded single-mode guides.
visual_evidence: Four narrow, equal-width access guides terminate at the north, south, east, and west footprint edges.
Each access guide feeds one smooth petal-shaped expansion whose width peaks about halfway to the center and contracts back to the narrow guide width at the central crossing.
The horizontal and vertical shapes are congruent and overlap at the center; there is no etched gap between them.
topology_reasoning.operating_principle: The smooth lobes adiabatically expand the access-guide mode into a wider multimode section and contract it at the shared orthogonal crossing. Fourfold symmetry preserves the intended straight-through paths, while the shaped expansion controls diffraction, reflection, and coupling into the orthogonal guide.

function_defining_knobs.guide_width: Sets the single-mode access and central throat width.
function_defining_knobs.lobe_length: Sets the adiabatic interaction/expansion length from the center to each outer access guide.
function_defining_knobs.lobe_max_width: Sets the widest multimode cross-section and therefore modal evolution through the crossing.
function_defining_knobs.profile_exponent: Controls how rapidly each lobe opens and closes while retaining the same endpoints and peak width.
function_defining_knobs.port_length: Sets the narrow access length between each lobe and the footprint boundary.

topology_reasoning.planned_construction: Extrude one straight gf.Path with a symmetric analytic width function, add an orthogonally rotated copy, and assemble the two primitive extrusions in an @gf.cell component on layer (1, 0).

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive reconstruction from the pre-code pixel measurements: two orthogonal variable-width gf.Path extrusions whose width profiles are the union of a 0.230 um guide and paired 1.807 x 0.906 um elliptical lobes centered 0.861 um from the crossing.
iterations.diff_observation: Only thin alternating red/blue contours remain along the smooth lobe boundaries, plus isolated one-pixel footprint-edge offsets. The 0.85 stop threshold was exceeded, so no further scored refinement was performed.

knob_verification.audit_note: The first check exposed that GDSFactory metadata made $$$CONTEXT_INFO$$$ the only top-level cell, which the area evaluator correctly excludes. device.py was changed to write_gds(..., with_metadata=False); the second check measured the unchanged device geometry and passed both length and area response tests.

final_selection.stop_reason: IoU exceeded the binding 0.85 threshold on the first scored comparison.
final_selection.implementation_update_from_precode_plan: Quantitative contour fitting showed that paired ellipses describe each lobed axis directly, so lobe_center_offset replaced the provisional profile_exponent and access length is represented by the live total path lengths.
